note: Private 40-acre RV park and bluegrass music venue, 902B Vernon Williams Rd, Hazlehurst. Big-rig-friendly; 2 bathhouses. Music events are an amenity, not a restriction. Also rents campers, buses and a bunkhouse, and hosts weddings and reunions. --Claude
summary: Booking moved from Firefly to Campspot (Reserve Now -> campspot.com/book/stagger-lee-music-rv-park), platform campspot added. Priced: $35 site charge on every RV type, Tuesday and Saturday, Nov 2026 and Jan 2027 (park 3% transaction fee + Campspot $3 = $39.05) - note's '$25-30' was out of date. 140 sites (130 RV with 30/50 A, 10 tent), 45 ft max, pull-through. Hookups/facilities now operator-sourced; season year-round (bookable in January). Long-stay: all 130 RV sites sold nightly on Campspot, 129 free on Saturday 2026-11-07 - passes. Note cleaned (counts, hookups, amenities, rate, booking engine, RV Life line). Phone 912-367-7900 matches site and Campspot; Campspot's point is 25 m from the pin.
flags: Events: Campspot shows the park closed 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-18 (likely the Bluegrass Festival the home page promotes); festival weeks may be ticketed/closed to ordinary bookings. Not a restriction outside them.
